cyg.translation: abbr. contains Deneb; Northern Cross 包含天津四; 北十字; Cygnus (Latin=Swan constellation) （拉丁语）天鹅星座

cygnets.translation: n. 幼天鹅( cygnet的复数形式 )

cygnus.definition:
n. a constellation in the northern hemisphere between Pegasus and Draco in the Milky Way; contains a black hole
n. a genus of Anatidae

cygnus atratus.translation: [网络] 黑天鹅；黑天鹅的气管

cygnus cygnus.translation: [网络] 大天鹅；黄嘴天鹅；天鹅属的模式种大天鹅

cygnus olor.translation: [网络] 疣鼻天鹅；瘤鹄；大天鹅
